entry.title: hr
entry.summary: Glossary terms for the hr context.
entry.content:
How the organisation hires, supports, and develops the people who work in it.

policy

A written rule that governs how employees are expected to act — a leave rule or a code of conduct, for instance — approved by the people team.

Examples:

  • A remote-work rule setting core collaboration hours.

onboarding

The structured first weeks of a new hire’s employment — access, training, and introductions — until they can work without close guidance.

Examples:

  • A thirty-day plan with a named buddy and a week-one checklist.
